# routeros_tool_romon (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_tool_romon" "romon" {
  enabled  = true
  romon_id = "00:00:5E:00:53:01"
  secrets  = "changeme"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___ts___` (String) <em>A set of transformations for field names. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the RoMON agent is enabled on this device.
- `romon_id` (String) Individual RoMON ID of the device, sent on the wire as the RouterOS `id` property. When left at `00:00:00:00:00:00` the lowest MAC address of the device is used.
- `secrets` (String, Sensitive) Comma separated list of secrets used for RoMON message authentication, integrity check and replay prevention. Per-port secrets can be set in `/tool/romon/port`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/tool/romon get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_tool_romon.romon "*1"
```
